data_role: 2026 EXPOSED DEVELOPMENT; EVAL already read in scale-002, E1, E1b, E4 (SEQ-001); advisory labels only; no winner, no adoption
question: Do the E3 post-hoc calibrators (fit per seed on CAL only) repair the top-label ECE of the N1 sequence model (EXP-WS-SEQ-001) on EVAL without degrading NLL/Brier? Which calibrator does the pre-registered CAL-CV selection rule pick, and how do the fan-display leaves (narrow_whiff, ground_ball_in_play) look?

source.review_verdict: PASS (independent reviewer, distinct from author; 0 critical/high/medium)
source.inputs: EXP-WS-SEQ-001 N1 seeds 0,1,2 margins/temperatures (gpu-pull ws-seq-001), scale-002 corpus.npz, E1 eval-meta.npz, baselines P (EXP-WS-RECENCY-002) and N0 ensemble (SEQ-001), reference N1 ensemble (SEQ-001)

arms: C0 recorded scalar T per head; C1 vector + Platt; C2 Dirichlet ODIR (lambda by inner CV); C3 per-leaf isotonic + renormalise; SEL = per-seed arm chosen by the pre-registered CAL 5-fold game-grouped CV rule (argmin CV top-label ECE subject to CV NLL <= C0 + 0.0010): seed0 C3, seed1 C2, seed2 C2. Ensemble = mean of the three seeds' calibrated seven-leaf rows.

paired_EVAL_ensemble_vs_C0.bootstrap: whole-game paired, 10000 draws, seed 20261211, pitch-weighted ratio of game sums, ECE from per-game bin sums, percentile 95%
paired_EVAL_ensemble_vs_C0.format: [difference, [ci95 lower, ci95 upper]] rounded to 5 decimals; exact values in the job result.json

interpretation: Calibration partly repairs the sequence model's top-label ECE. The per-seed CAL-CV selection (the pre-registered mechanism: seed0 C3, seeds1-2 C2) brings the ensemble ECE from 0.00678 to 0.00450 (SEL-C0 -0.00228, CI [-0.00424, +0.00009] just touching zero) while slightly improving NLL (-0.00037, CI below zero) and Brier; after calibration the ECE gap to the tree is no longer significant (SEL-P +0.00224 [-0.00126, +0.00387] vs C0-P +0.00452 [+0.00049, +0.00614]) and the NLL advantage over the tree grows to -0.00398. Applying isotonic (C3) to all three seeds would reach ECE 0.00338 with a CI excluding zero (the only arm labelled CANDIDATE), but that is a post-hoc reading of an EVAL split that has now been read six times today; the pre-registered SEL is the honest choice and it is 'almost there'. The fan-display leaves were never badly calibrated: narrow_whiff and ground_ball ECE are 0.001-0.003 for every arm, monotone, far under the 0.01 threshold; the miscalibration is in the ball/other_strike leaves (top-label bins 0.5-0.7 under-confident). LIMITS: exposed development, no multiplicity correction, per-fold ECE is a noisy selection statistic (hence the seed-dependent arm choice), 3 seeds. Reuse: the same script and selection rule are the registered final stage of EXP-WS-SEQ-002.
